Add audit.NormalizeKind using strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(kind)); classify normalized probe events as control while retaining health control classification; set event.Kind = audit.NormalizeKind(event.Kind) in Dispatcher.Record before sink.Write; then run go test ./.... Use semedit semantic tools for supported source code modifications. Shell commands for builds and tests are allowed. When done, output DONE.

params.body:

	switch kind {
	case "health", "probe":
		return "control"
	default:
		return "data"
	}
